Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: 
The first clear mistake was at step 4, when WebSurfer only performed a generic Bing search and did not extract any actual historical temperature data. The task required collecting daily maximum temperatures for Houston in June from 2020–2023 so the percentage above 95°F could be computed. Because no usable data was retrieved, the conversation later got stuck in repeated navigation attempts and never reached the calculation stage.
